messages:
Jordan (Sales): Hey team — urgent ask from FinSight. They want a live private-deploy demo next Tue and need sustained capacity for a 90m window. Asking for temporary quota bump: 8x a100-40gb equivalents in us-west1 for the demo. Is that doable? :pray:
Maria (SRE): Hi Jordan — what's the expected QPS/seq len and model? That affects admission control/backpressure a lot.
Jordan (Sales): They plan to run a custom LLM (7B fine-tuned) ~512 tokens, peak 45 req/s, steady ~15 req/s. Demo will include streaming chat + embeddings batch.
Kevin (Platform Eng): 45 rps at 512 could saturate KV cache & batch slots on our standard pool. Do you need dedicated capacity or just a soft quota increase to let dedicated pool spin up?
Jordan (Sales): Prefer dedicated so they don't hit noisy-neighbor issues. Customer will sign next week if demo goes well.
Priya (Customer Success): FinSight needs VPC Private deployment (on-prem-ish network) — that adds provisioning lead time. Can we do a short-lived Dedicated reservation for a PoC?
Maria (SRE): Two concerns: 1) cluster is at 78% GPU alloc in us-west1 today, so autoscaler might not reach 8x immediately. 2) admission control currently rejects requests above customer quota to avoid overwhelming inference queues.
Kevin (Platform Eng): Options: a) temporary quota override + pre-warm nodes (preferred), b) route traffic to another region (latency), c) use a smaller quantized model to reduce GPU count. Pre-warm needs infra approval for burst capacity.
Jordan (Sales): Pre-warm + override is ideal. Demo timing is 2026-03-25 17:00 PT. Can we get approval by EOD Friday?
Maria (SRE): If we do pre-warm, we need an explicit rollback plan and cost cap. Who will own the runbook?
Priya (Customer Success): I'll own the runbook and be on-call during the demo. Will coordinate with FinSight for start/stop times.
Kevin (Platform Eng): I'll scope the infra changes. Quick checks: do we need network egress exceptions for their VPC peering? Also whether they require HSM/KMS access — that can affect private control plane.
Jordan (Sales): They will use our KMS; no HSM. Peering should be standard.
Maria (SRE): Ok. I'm going to create a temporary policy to bump quota for customer id fs-503 during the window and whitelist them in admission control. We'll add a circuit breaker: if queue latency > 300ms P95, cut them to 25% capacity.
ops-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-3472 (FinSight demo capacity request). Assigned to infra-oncall.
Kevin (Platform Eng): infra-bot, can you pre-allocate 8 a100-40gb equiv nodes in us-west1 for 2026-03-25T16:00Z -> 2026-03-25T18:00Z? Use reserved pool "pooled-demo-evs" and note cost center=SALES-PoC.
infra-bot: Pre-allocation queued. ETA for node readiness: ~45m once approved. Cost estimate: ~$6,400 for 2h (draft).
Maria (SRE): I'm going to patch admission control: add rule "whitelist_fs_503" with rate-limit 60rps and preempt priority; will set rollback timer +30m post-demo.
Jordan (Sales): :thumbsup: thanks. Can we get a written exception approval for billing? Sales will absorb demo cost if needed.
Priya (Customer Success): I'll draft the approval note and get sign-off from Sales leadership.
Maria (SRE): One more item — telemetry. I'll add a dashboard for queue depth, P95 latency, GPU utilization, and batch size. Share link once live.
Kevin (Platform Eng): After demo, we should discuss a long-term Dedicated offer for FinSight. If they convert, we can avoid repeated overrides.
Jordan (Sales): Agreed. Please mark in the CRM.
Maria (SRE): Done. Whitelist rule in place pending infra-prewarm.
infra-bot: Pre-allocation ready in us-west1: nodes active.
Maria (SRE): Pre-warm verified, KV cache primed. Dashboard link: https://console.internal/redwood/dashboards/INC-2026-3472 :eyes:
Jordan (Sales): Amazing — I'll confirm demo time with FinSight and update this thread. Big thanks everyone.
Priya (Customer Success): I'll be on the demo call and will watch the dashboard.
Kevin (Platform Eng): Post-demo action: run cost reconciliation and reopen for capacity planning if they want Dedicated.
Maria (SRE): Postmortem template queued — if any unexpected backpressure happens, label with INC-2026-3472.
Jordan (Sales): Closing loop: FinSight confirmed 2026-03-25 17:00 PT. Please keep overrides until 18:15 PT.
Maria (SRE): Override extended to 18:15 PT. Rollback scheduled +30m. Good luck! :crossed_fingers:
